arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Ms. Leiter argued Congress enacted the law to reduce federal court burdens.
Ms. Saharsky argued the statute does not bar review of reopen denials.
Mr. Schoenfield argued Congress limited review only to specific subchapter authorities.
